fixes: **The "up to date" badge no longer trusts a stale check.** If the daily update check stops running — its background container is down, or the host has lost outbound internet after one earlier success — the footer used to go on showing "(Latest)" indefinitely: a reassuring answer that was no longer being confirmed. It now drops the "(Latest)" claim once the last check is older than three days, so a stalled checker is visible instead of silent. A release that is already known to be available is still flagged regardless of the check's age. ---
